test_cases.description: Verify transmission of IVT_Receipt_Envelope and IVT_Receipt_Content when LRU_Basic_PIVT_Fault is True after PIVT Basic Test completion.
test_cases.initial_condition: LRU_Basic_PIVT_Fault set to True before PIVT Basic Test completion.
test_cases.test_inputs: Completion of PIVT Basic Test.
test_cases.expected_result: IVT_Receipt_Envelope transmitted as 0x0020 and IVT_Receipt_Content transmitted as 0x0001 over STL Bus.
test_cases.pass_criteria: Observed envelope equals 0x0020 and content equals 0x0001.
test_cases.test_procedure_notes: Simulate PIVT Basic Test completion with fault flag set to True and capture transmitted values.

test_cases.description: Verify transmission of IVT_Receipt_Envelope and IVT_Receipt_Content when LRU_Basic_PIVT_Fault is False after PIVT Basic Test completion.
test_cases.initial_condition: LRU_Basic_PIVT_Fault set to False before PIVT Basic Test completion.
test_cases.test_inputs: Completion of PIVT Basic Test.
test_cases.expected_result: IVT_Receipt_Envelope transmitted as 0x0020 and IVT_Receipt_Content transmitted as 0x0000 over STL Bus.
test_cases.pass_criteria: Observed envelope equals 0x0020 and content equals 0x0000.
test_cases.test_procedure_notes: Simulate PIVT Basic Test completion with fault flag set to False and capture transmitted values.

test_cases.description: Verify that IVT_Receipt_Envelope and IVT_Receipt_Content retain previous value until a new PIVT result is available.
test_cases.initial_condition: First PIVT Basic Test completed with LRU_Basic_PIVT_Fault = True, second test pending.
test_cases.test_inputs: First PIVT Basic Test completion followed by second PIVT Basic Test completion with LRU_Basic_PIVT_Fault = False.
test_cases.expected_result: After first test, content = 0x0001; before second test, content remains 0x0001; after second test, content = 0x0000.
test_cases.pass_criteria: Observed values match the expected sequence of content values.
test_cases.test_procedure_notes: Capture content value immediately after first test and again immediately before second test to confirm persistence.

test_cases.description: Verify that IVT_Receipt_Envelope and IVT_Receipt_Content faults are cleared during power‑up initialization.
test_cases.initial_condition: System powered up and initialized.
test_cases.test_inputs: Power‑up sequence.
test_cases.expected_result: IVT_Receipt_Envelope and IVT_Receipt_Content hold cleared values (0x0000).
test_cases.pass_criteria: Observed values equal 0x0000 after power‑up.
test_cases.test_procedure_notes: Observe transmitted values immediately after power‑up initialization.

test_cases.description: Verify that IVT_Receipt_Envelope and IVT_Receipt_Content faults are cleared upon entry into PIVT Test Suite 2.
test_cases.initial_condition: System in normal operation with previous fault values transmitted.
test_cases.test_inputs: Command to enter PIVT Test Suite 2.
test_cases.expected_result: IVT_Receipt_Envelope and IVT_Receipt_Content cleared to 0x0000.
test_cases.pass_criteria: Observed values equal 0x0000 after entering Test Suite 2.
test_cases.test_procedure_notes: Trigger entry into Test Suite 2 and capture transmitted values.

test_cases.description: Verify that IVT_Receipt_Envelope and IVT_Receipt_Content faults are cleared upon exit from IVT mode as commanded by IVT_Active_STL.
test_cases.initial_condition: System in IVT mode with fault values transmitted.
test_cases.test_inputs: Command to exit IVT mode via IVT_Active_STL.
test_cases.expected_result: IVT_Receipt_Envelope and IVT_Receipt_Content cleared to 0x0000.
test_cases.pass_criteria: Observed values equal 0x0000 after exit from IVT mode.
test_cases.test_procedure_notes: Execute exit command and verify transmitted values.

test_cases.description: Verify that the LRU software repeats the RAM Memory test once when a failure occurs.
test_cases.initial_condition: System initialized; RAM Memory test has not yet been executed.
test_cases.test_inputs: Simulate a RAM Memory test failure during the first execution.
test_cases.expected_result: RAM Memory test is executed again immediately after the failure.
test_cases.pass_criteria: Repeat count equals 1.
test_cases.test_procedure_notes: 1. Trigger a RAM Memory test failure. 2. Observe the test execution sequence. 3. Count the number of times the RAM Memory test is executed.

test_cases.description: Verify that the LRU software does not repeat the RAM Memory test more than once upon a failure.
test_cases.initial_condition: System initialized; RAM Memory test has not yet been executed.
test_cases.test_inputs: Simulate a RAM Memory test failure during the first execution.
test_cases.expected_result: RAM Memory test is executed only twice total (original + one repeat).
test_cases.pass_criteria: Total execution count equals 2.
test_cases.test_procedure_notes: 1. Trigger a RAM Memory test failure. 2. Monitor the test executions. 3. Ensure no further repeats after the first repeat.

test_cases.description: Verify that RAM_Fault_GndOp is set to TRUE when RAM Memory Test fails after the second attempt.
test_cases.initial_condition: RAM_Fault_GndOp is FALSE; no RAM Memory Test has been performed yet.
test_cases.test_inputs: Simulate a successful RAM Memory Test on the first attempt and a failure on the second attempt.
test_cases.expected_result: RAM_Fault_GndOp is set to TRUE after the second attempt failure.
test_cases.pass_criteria: RAM_Fault_GndOp equals TRUE immediately following the second attempt failure.
test_cases.test_procedure_notes: 1. Initialize RAM_Fault_GndOp to FALSE. 2. Perform first RAM Memory Test and simulate success. 3. Perform second RAM Memory Test and simulate failure. 4. Verify that RAM_Fault_GndOp is TRUE.

test_cases.description: Verify that the LRU software sends IVT_Receipt_Envelope and IVT_Receipt_Content when RAM_Fault_GndOp is True and Translation_Fault_GndOp is False.
test_cases.initial_condition: LRU software initialized with no faults.
test_cases.test_inputs: Set RAM_Fault_GndOp = True; Translation_Fault_GndOp = False.
test_cases.expected_result: IVT_Receipt_Envelope (0x0020) and IVT_Receipt_Content (0x0001) are transmitted; LRU_Basic_PIVT_Fault is set to True.
test_cases.pass_criteria: Transmission of both envelope and content occurs and LRU_Basic_PIVT_Fault flag is True.
test_cases.test_procedure_notes: Confirm that the transmitted messages match the specified hex values and that the fault flag is updated accordingly.

test_cases.description: Verify that the LRU software sends IVT_Receipt_Envelope and IVT_Receipt_Content when Translation_Fault_GndOp is True and RAM_Fault_GndOp is False.
test_cases.initial_condition: LRU software initialized with no faults.
test_cases.test_inputs: Set RAM_Fault_GndOp = False; Translation_Fault_GndOp = True.
test_cases.expected_result: IVT_Receipt_Envelope (0x0020) and IVT_Receipt_Content (0x0001) are transmitted; LRU_Basic_PIVT_Fault is set to True.
test_cases.pass_criteria: Transmission of both envelope and content occurs and LRU_Basic_PIVT_Fault flag is True.
test_cases.test_procedure_notes: Verify that the transmitted messages match the specified hex values and that the fault flag is updated accordingly.

test_cases.description: Verify that the LRU software sends IVT_Receipt_Envelope and IVT_Receipt_Content when both RAM_Fault_GndOp and Translation_Fault_GndOp are True.
test_cases.initial_condition: LRU software initialized with no faults.
test_cases.test_inputs: Set RAM_Fault_GndOp = True; Translation_Fault_GndOp = True.
test_cases.expected_result: IVT_Receipt_Envelope (0x0020) and IVT_Receipt_Content (0x0001) are transmitted; LRU_Basic_PIVT_Fault is set to True.
test_cases.pass_criteria: Transmission of both envelope and content occurs and LRU_Basic_PIVT_Fault flag is True.
test_cases.test_procedure_notes: Confirm that the transmitted messages match the specified hex values and that the fault flag is updated accordingly.

test_cases.description: Verify that the LRU software does not send IVT_Receipt_Envelope or IVT_Receipt_Content when neither RAM_Fault_GndOp nor Translation_Fault_GndOp are True.
test_cases.initial_condition: LRU software initialized with no faults.
test_cases.test_inputs: Set RAM_Fault_GndOp = False; Translation_Fault_GndOp = False.
test_cases.expected_result: No IVT_Receipt_Envelope or IVT_Receipt_Content is transmitted; LRU_Basic_PIVT_Fault remains False.
test_cases.pass_criteria: Absence of transmission and fault flag remains False.
test_cases.test_procedure_notes: Ensure that no messages are sent and the fault flag is not set when both fault conditions are false.

test_cases.description: Verify that the LRU software sends IVT_Receipt_Envelope (0x0020) and IVT_Receipt_Content (0x0000) when both RAM_Fault_GndOp and Translation_Fault_GndOp are False.
test_cases.initial_condition: LRU system initialized with RAM_Fault_GndOp = False and Translation_Fault_GndOp = False.
test_cases.test_inputs: Set RAM_Fault_GndOp to False and Translation_Fault_GndOp to False.
test_cases.expected_result: LRU_Basic_PIVT_Fault is False and the software transmits IVT_Receipt_Envelope with value 0x0020 and IVT_Receipt_Content with value 0x0000.
test_cases.pass_criteria: The transmitted envelope and content match the expected values 0x0020 and 0x0000 respectively, and LRU_Basic_PIVT_Fault remains False.
test_cases.test_procedure_notes: Confirm that no other messages are transmitted during this test and that the LRU_Basic_PIVT_Fault flag is not set.

test_cases.description: Verify that Valve_On is False during the RAM Memory test.
test_cases.initial_condition: LRU initialized and RAM Memory test active.
test_cases.expected_result: Valve_On output equals False.
test_cases.pass_criteria: Valve_On output must be False during the RAM Memory test.
test_cases.test_procedure_notes: Confirm that no valve activation occurs during the RAM Memory test.

test_cases.description: Verify that Hi_Enable_Envelope is False during the RAM Memory test.
test_cases.initial_condition: LRU initialized and RAM Memory test active.
test_cases.expected_result: Hi_Enable_Envelope output equals False.
test_cases.pass_criteria: Hi_Enable_Envelope output must be False during the RAM Memory test.
test_cases.test_procedure_notes: Ensure high envelope enable signal remains inactive during the RAM Memory test.

test_cases.description: Verify that Device_Charge_Order_Lim equals 0.0 during the RAM Memory test.
test_cases.initial_condition: LRU initialized and RAM Memory test active.
test_cases.expected_result: Device_Charge_Order_Lim output equals 0.0.
test_cases.pass_criteria: Device_Charge_Order_Lim must be 0.0 during the RAM Memory test.
test_cases.test_procedure_notes: Check that the device charge order limit is set to zero during the RAM Memory test.

test_cases.description: Verify that STL_LRU_LRU2 is Enabled during the RAM Memory test.
test_cases.initial_condition: LRU initialized and RAM Memory test active.
test_cases.expected_result: STL_LRU_LRU2 output equals Enabled.
test_cases.pass_criteria: STL_LRU_LRU2 must be Enabled during the RAM Memory test.
test_cases.test_procedure_notes: Confirm that STL_LRU_LRU2 remains enabled after initialization and during the RAM Memory test.

test_cases.description: Verify that all specified outputs maintain their required states simultaneously during the RAM Memory test.
test_cases.initial_condition: LRU initialized and RAM Memory test active.
test_cases.expected_result: Valve_On is False, Hi_Enable_Envelope is False, Device_Charge_Order_Lim is 0.0, STL_LRU_LRU2 is Enabled.
test_cases.pass_criteria: All outputs must match the expected states during the RAM Memory test.
test_cases.test_procedure_notes: Simultaneously monitor all outputs to ensure they remain in the specified states throughout the RAM Memory test.

test_cases.description: Verify that the RAM Memory Test writes and reads back the test pattern 0x55555555 correctly.
test_cases.initial_condition: RAM contents are undefined prior to test execution.
test_cases.test_inputs: Write value 0x55555555 to address 0x0009DFF9.
test_cases.expected_result: Read back value 0x55555555 from address 0x0009DFF9.
test_cases.pass_criteria: The value read from the RAM matches the value written (0x55555555).
test_cases.test_procedure_notes: 1. Select a valid RAM address within Block 0 (e.g., 0x0009DFF9). 2. Write the pattern 0x55555555 to that address. 3. Read back the value from the same address. 4. Compare the read value to the written pattern.

test_cases.description: Verify that the RAM Memory Test writes and reads back the test pattern 0xAAAAAAAA correctly.
test_cases.initial_condition: RAM contents are undefined prior to test execution.
test_cases.test_inputs: Write value 0xAAAAAAAA to address 0x0009DFFA.
test_cases.expected_result: Read back value 0xAAAAAAAA from address 0x0009DFFA.
test_cases.pass_criteria: The value read from the RAM matches the value written (0xAAAAAAAA).
test_cases.test_procedure_notes: 1. Select a valid RAM address within Block 0 (e.g., 0x0009DFFA). 2. Write the pattern 0xAAAAAAAA to that address. 3. Read back the value from the same address. 4. Compare the read value to the written pattern.

test_cases.description: Verify that the RAM Memory Test writes and reads back the test pattern 0 correctly.
test_cases.initial_condition: RAM contents are undefined prior to test execution.
test_cases.test_inputs: Write value 0x00000000 to address 0x0009DFFB.
test_cases.expected_result: Read back value 0x00000000 from address 0x0009DFFB.
test_cases.pass_criteria: The value read from the RAM matches the value written (0x00000000).
test_cases.test_procedure_notes: 1. Select a valid RAM address within Block 0 (e.g., 0x0009DFFB). 2. Write the pattern 0x00000000 to that address. 3. Read back the value from the same address. 4. Compare the read value to the written pattern.

test_cases.description: Verify the walking address test pattern by writing each address value into its own location within Block 1.
test_cases.initial_condition: RAM contents are undefined prior to test execution.
test_cases.test_inputs: Write address value 0x000BDDC0 to address 0x000BDDC0; write address value 0x000BDDC1 to address 0x000BDDC1; write address value 0x000BDDC2 to address 0x000BDDC2.
test_cases.expected_result: Read back values 0x000BDDC0, 0x000BDDC1, and 0x000BDDC2 from their respective addresses.
test_cases.pass_criteria: Each read value matches the address value written to that location.
test_cases.test_procedure_notes: 1. For each address in the selected range within Block 1, write the address value to that address. 2. Read back the value from each address. 3. Verify that the read value equals the address written.
